description: Returns one jwatte.com article series by its id: its title, kind (hub for a series index page, parts for a numbered series), link and description, then its sections in the order the site gives them, each with its articles in reading order. Every article has an id of the form article:<slug>, its title, its canonical https link, its publication date and, in a numbered series, its part number (null otherwise). Answers come from the copy of the site bundled with this server; nothing is read from the web. A host that supports interactive views can also show the series as a list of links.

id.description: A series id, lowercase words joined by hyphens, e.g. "who-gets-the-yield".

name: get_series
